newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 200 mln fixed bonds at tender.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 200 mln fixed bonds at tender.

text.p: The Polish treasury sold all 200 million zlotys of 12-percent five-year bonds on offer after investors bid for 346 million zlotys worth of the bonds, the finance ministry said.
The treasury set the minimum price at 80.47 and the average accepted price was 80.72.

The bonds on auction mature on June 12, 2001 and come from an earlier three billion zloty issue of 12-percent five-year bonds, from which 1.736 billion was sold at four consecutive tenders from February to May of last year.
The value date for this tender is March 5, 1997.
Earlier this month the treasury sold similar 12-percent five year bonds, due on July 12, 2002, at a minimum price of 79.30 and an average price of 79.61.
